name: Chronicles of Ella: Whispers of Mythrillis
source:
A lost mercenary navigates a dangerous monster girl village, where every choice, lie, and word could mean survival—or exposure. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3897000/Chronicles_of_Ella_Whispers_of_Mythrillis/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一名迷途的雇佣兵孤身闯入危机四伏的魔物娘村落；在这里，每一个抉择、每一句谎言、每一个字眼，都可能决定你是侥幸活命——还是当场暴露。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3897000/Chronicles_of_Ella_Whispers_of_Mythrillis/]Steam[/url]]
